Helbital.name: Helbital
Helbital.description: Named after the norse goddess Hel, this medicine heals the patient's bruises the closer they are to death. Patients will find the medicine 'aids' their healing if not near death by causing asphyxiation.

Libital.name: Libital
Libital.description: A bruise reliever. Does minor liver damage.
Libital.taste_description: bitter with a hint of alcohol

Probital.name: Probital
Probital.description: Originally developed as a prototype-gym supliment for those looking for quick workout turnover, this oral medication quickly repairs broken muscle tissue but causes lactic acid buildup, tiring the patient. Overdosing can cause extreme drowsiness. An Influx of nutrients promotes the muscle repair even further.

Lenturi.name: Lenturi
Lenturi.description: Used to treat burns. Makes you move slower while it is in your system. Applies stomach damage when it leaves your system.

Aiuri.name: Aiuri
Aiuri.description: Used to treat burns. Does minor eye damage.

Hercuri.name: Hercuri
Hercuri.description: Not to be confused with element Mercury, this medicine excels in reverting effects of dangerous high-temperature environments. Prolonged exposure can cause hypothermia.

Convermol.name: Convermol
Convermol.description: Restores oxygen deprivation while producing a lesser amount of toxic byproducts. Both scale with exposure to the drug and current amount of oxygen deprivation. Overdose causes toxic byproducts regardless of oxygen deprivation.

Tirimol.name: Tirimol
Tirimol.description: An oxygen deprivation medication that causes fatigue. Prolonged exposure causes the patient to fall asleep once the medicine metabolizes.

Seiver.name: Seiver
Seiver.description: A medicine that shifts functionality based on temperature. Colder temperatures incurs radiation removal while hotter temperatures promote antitoxicity. Damages the heart.

Multiver.name: Multiver
Multiver.description: A chem-purger that becomes more effective the more unique medicines present. Slightly heals toxicity but causes lung damage (mitigatable by unique medicines).

Syriniver.name: Syriniver
Syriniver.description: A potent antidote for intravenous use with a narrow therapeutic index, it is considered an active prodrug of musiver.

Musiver.name: Musiver
Musiver.description: The active metabolite of syriniver. Causes muscle weakness on overdose

Synthflesh (Instabitaluri).name: Synthflesh (Instabitaluri)
Synthflesh (Instabitaluri).description: Heals brute and burn damage at the cost of toxicity (66% of damage healed). Touch application only.

Penthrite.name: Penthrite
Penthrite.description: An expensive medicine that aids with pumping blood around the body even without a heart, and prevents the heart from slowing down. It reacts violently with other emergency medication.

Orange Juice.name: Orange Juice
Orange Juice.description: Both delicious AND rich in Vitamin C, what more do you need?

Tomato Juice.name: Tomato Juice
Tomato Juice.description: Tomatoes made into juice. What a waste of big, juicy tomatoes, huh?

Carrot Juice.name: Carrot Juice
Carrot Juice.description: It is just like a carrot but without crunching.

Berry Juice.name: Berry Juice
Berry Juice.description: A delicious blend of several different kinds of berries.

Apple Juice.name: Apple Juice
Apple Juice.description: The sweet juice of an apple, fit for all ages.

Poison Berry Juice.name: Poison Berry Juice
Poison Berry Juice.description: A tasty juice blended from various kinds of very deadly and toxic berries.

Dote Juice.name: Dote Juice
Dote Juice.description: A delicious juice made from Dote berries

Dotu Juice.name: Dotu Juice
Dotu Juice.description: A neutral juice made from ripe Dote fruit.

Refa-Li Juice.name: Refa-Li Juice
Refa-Li Juice.description: Refa-Li is spicy, unless the seeds have been removed, in which case it takes on a more mellow, earthly tone

Banana Juice.name: Banana Juice
Banana Juice.description: The raw essence of a banana.

Laughter.name: Laughter
Laughter.description: Some say that this is the best medicine, but recent studies have proven that to be untrue.

Super Laughter.name: Super Laughter
Super Laughter.description: Funny until you're the one laughing.

Grape Juice.name: Grape Juice
Grape Juice.description: The juice of a bunch of grapes. Guaranteed non-alcoholic.

Milk.name: Milk
Milk.description: An opaque white liquid produced by the mammary glands of mammals, some arthropods, biogenerators, chemical factories...

Tiris Milk.name: Tiris Milk
Tiris Milk.description: A strong, tangy milk made by a Tiris. Makes a very good cheese.

Soy Milk.name: Soy Milk
Soy Milk.description: An opaque white liquid made from soybeans.

Cream.name: Cream
Cream.description: The fatty, still liquid part of milk.

Coffee.name: Coffee
Coffee.description: Coffee is a brewed drink prepared from roasted seeds, commonly called coffee beans, of the coffee plant.

Coffee Creamer.name: Coffee Creamer
Coffee Creamer.description: Powdered milk for cheap coffee. How delightful.

Lemonade.name: Lemonade
Lemonade.description: Sweet, tangy lemonade. Good for the soul.

Iced Coffee.name: Iced Coffee
Iced Coffee.description: Coffee and ice, refreshing and cool.

Hot Ice Coffee.name: Hot Ice Coffee
Hot Ice Coffee.taste_description: bitter coldness and a hint of smoke

Crosstalk.name: Crosstalk
Crosstalk.description: Crosstalk! Share the energy with everyone!
Crosstalk.taste_description: carbonated battery acid with a spoonful of sugar

Comet Trail.name: Comet Trail
Comet Trail.description: A citrusy drink from the Kepori space installation known as The Ring.

Tadrixx.name: Tadrixx
Tadrixx.description: A Kalixcian drink made from a plant that tastes similar to sassafrass, which is used in root beer. A stumpy drake holding a mug of it is on the front.

Space-Up.name: Space-Up
Space-Up.description: Tastes like a hull breach in your mouth.

Molten Bubbles.name: Molten Bubbles
Molten Bubbles.description: A spicy soft drink made from a coca-like plant from Kalixcis. Popularly served both cold -and- hot, depending on the weather.

Plasma Fizz.name: Plasma Fizz
Plasma Fizz.description: A  spinoff of the popular Molten Bubbles drink from Kalixcis, made to emulate the flavor of spiced grape instead. It's... not exactly convincing or a very good mix.

Sandblast Sarsaparilla.name: Sandblast Sarsaparilla
Sandblast Sarsaparilla.description: Extra refreshing for those long desert days.

Lemon Lime.name: Lemon Lime
Lemon Lime.description: A tangy substance made of 0.5% natural citrus!

PAC-Fuel.name: PAC-Fuel
PAC-Fuel.description: A carbonated energy drink themed after the purple coloration, similar to plasma.

Tonic Water.name: Tonic Water
Tonic Water.description: It tastes strange, and it's not like malaria is much of an issue anymore.

Xeno-Energy.name: Xeno-Energy
Xeno-Energy.description: An unbearably sugary, fizzy green drink.

Ice.name: Ice
Ice.description: Frozen water, your dentist wouldn't like you chewing this.

Soy Latte.name: Soy Latte
Soy Latte.description: A hot beverage for those who can't handle the lactose.

Cafe Latte.name: Cafe Latte
Cafe Latte.description: A nice, strong and tasty beverage while you are reading.

The Doctor's Delight.name: The Doctor's Delight
The Doctor's Delight.description: A homemade curative. A mixture of juices that helps your body heal against most damage, at the cost of leaving you hungry.

Chocolate Pudding.name: Chocolate Pudding
Chocolate Pudding.description: A great dessert for chocolate lovers.

Vanilla Pudding.name: Vanilla Pudding
Vanilla Pudding.description: A great dessert for vanilla lovers.

Pumpkin Latte.name: Pumpkin Latte
Pumpkin Latte.description: A mix of spices and coffee. It doesn't actually contain any pumpkin, though.

Tadrixx Float.name: Tadrixx Float
Tadrixx Float.description: Ice cream on top of a glass of Tadrixx.

Chocolate Milk.name: Chocolate Milk
Chocolate Milk.description: Milk mixed with chocolate powder. Beloved by children everywhere.

Lunapunch.name: Lunapunch
Lunapunch.description: An herbal-sweet carbonated drink with a bitter bite.

Hot Cocoa.name: Hot Cocoa
Hot Cocoa.description: Made with love and cocoa beans. Or from a vending machine.

Menthol.name: Menthol
Menthol.description: Alleviates coughing symptoms one might have.

Cream Soda.name: Cream Soda
Cream Soda.description: A classic vanilla flavored soft drink.

Sol Dry.name: Sol Dry
Sol Dry.description: A soothing, mellow drink made from ginger.

Red Queen.name: Red Queen
Red Queen.description: You feel inclined to drink it, somehow.

pruno mixture.name: pruno mixture
pruno mixture.description: Fruit, sugar, yeast, and water pulped together into a pungent slurry.

Lean.name: Lean
Lean.description: The drank that makes you go wheezy.
Lean.taste_description: purple and a hint of opioid.

Dropsight.name: Dropsight
Dropsight.description: An illegal chemical compound used as drug.

Nicotine.name: Nicotine
Nicotine.description: Slightly reduces stun times. If overdosed it will deal toxin and oxygen damage.

Crank.name: Crank
Crank.description: Reduces stun times by about 200%. If overdosed or addicted it will deal significant Toxin, Brute and Brain damage.

Methamphetamine.name: Methamphetamine
Methamphetamine.description: Reduces stun times by about 300%, speeds the user up, and allows the user to quickly recover stamina while dealing a small amount of Brain damage. If overdosed the subject will move randomly, drop items and suffer from Toxin and Brain damage. If addicted the subject will become dizzy, lose motor control and eventually suffer heavy toxin damage.

Mammoth.name: Mammoth
Mammoth.description: A muscle stimulant said to turn the user into an unarmed fighting machine. Greatly increases stamina regeneration and allows the user to tackle.

Aranesp.name: Aranesp
Aranesp.description: Amps you up, gets you going, and rapidly restores stamina damage. Side effects include breathlessness and toxicity.

Happiness.name: Happiness
Happiness.description: Fills you with ecstasic numbness and causes minor brain damage. Highly addictive. If overdosed causes sudden mood swings.

Pump-Up.name: Pump-Up
Pump-Up.description: Take on the world! A fast acting, hard hitting drug that pushes the limit on what you can handle.

Finobranc.name: Finobranc
Finobranc.description: A stimulant native to Sol. The seeds of the plant that serves as a precursor have spread throughout the frontier.

Shoalmix.name: Shoalmix
Shoalmix.description: An extremely potent mix of stimulants, painkillers, and performance enhancers that originated within the Shoal.
Shoalmix.taste_description: a metallic bitter permeating your flesh.

Retukemi.name: Retukemi
Retukemi.description: A marginally psychoactive compound commonly found in the leaves of the Uke-misikeci Rasi plant.

Stardrop.name: Stardrop
Stardrop.description: A vision-enhancing chemical that originated as a performance aid for industrial miners.

Starlight.name: Starlight
Starlight.description: A vision-enhancing chemical derived from stardrop. The original formula was a N+S recipe leaked by a GEC worker.

Placebatol.name: Placebatol
Placebatol.description: An odorless, colorless, powdery substance that's sometimes prescribed. May not actually do anything...?

Nutriment.name: Nutriment
Nutriment.description: All the vitamins, minerals, and carbohydrates the body needs in pure form.

Vitamin.name: Vitamin
Vitamin.description: All the best vitamins, minerals, and carbohydrates the body needs in pure form.

Protein.name: Protein
Protein.description: A natural polyamide made up of amino acids. An essential constituent of mosts known forms of life.

Cooking Oil.name: Cooking Oil
Cooking Oil.description: A variety of cooking oil derived from fat or plants. Used in food preparation and frying.

Sugar.name: Sugar
Sugar.description: The organic compound commonly known as table sugar and sometimes called saccharose. This white, odorless, crystalline powder has a pleasing, sweet taste.

Virus Food.name: Virus Food
Virus Food.description: A mixture of water and milk. Virus cells can use this mixture to reproduce.

Soysauce.name: Soysauce
Soysauce.description: A salty sauce made from the soy plant.

Ketchup.name: Ketchup
Ketchup.description: Ketchup, catsup, whatever. It's tomato paste.

Capsaicin Oil.name: Capsaicin Oil
Capsaicin Oil.description: This is what makes chilis hot.

Frost Oil.name: Frost Oil
Frost Oil.description: A special oil that noticeably chills the body. Extracted from chilly peppers and slimes.

Condensed Capsaicin.name: Condensed Capsaicin
Condensed Capsaicin.description: A chemical agent used for self-defense and in police work.

Table Salt.name: Table Salt
Table Salt.description: A salt made of sodium chloride. Commonly used to season food.

Coco Powder.name: Coco Powder
Coco Powder.description: A fatty, bitter paste made from coco beans.

Mushroom Hallucinogen.name: Mushroom Hallucinogen
Mushroom Hallucinogen.description: A strong hallucinogenic drug derived from certain species of mushroom.

Garlic Juice.name: Garlic Juice
Garlic Juice.description: Crushed garlic. Chefs love it, but it can make you smell bad.

Sprinkles.name: Sprinkles
Sprinkles.description: Multi-colored little bits of sugar, commonly found on donuts. Loved by cops.

Corn Oil.name: Corn Oil
Corn Oil.description: An oil derived from various types of corn.

Universal Enzyme.name: Universal Enzyme
Universal Enzyme.description: A universal enzyme used in the preparation of certain chemicals and foods.

Dry Ramen.name: Dry Ramen
Dry Ramen.description: Space age food, since August 25, 1958. Contains dried noodles, vegetables, and chemicals that boil in contact with water.

Hot Ramen.name: Hot Ramen
Hot Ramen.description: The noodles are boiled, the flavors are artificial, just like being back in school.

Nutraslop.name: Nutraslop
Nutraslop.description: Mixture of leftover prison foods served on previous days.

Hell Ramen.name: Hell Ramen
Hell Ramen.description: The noodles are boiled, the flavors are artificial, just like being back in school.
Hell Ramen.taste_description: wet and cheap noodles on fire

Flour.name: Flour
Flour.description: This is what you rub all over yourself to pretend to be a ghost.

Cherry Jelly.name: Cherry Jelly
Cherry Jelly.description: Totally the best. Only to be spread on foods with excellent lateral symmetry.

Blue Cherry Jelly.name: Blue Cherry Jelly
Blue Cherry Jelly.description: Blue and tastier kind of cherry jelly.

Vanilla Powder.name: Vanilla Powder
Vanilla Powder.description: A fatty, bitter paste made from vanilla pods.

Honey.name: Honey
Honey.description: Sweet sweet honey that decays into sugar. Has antibacterial and natural healing properties.

Mayonnaise.name: Mayonnaise
Mayonnaise.description: An white and oily mixture of mixed egg yolks.

Mold.name: Mold
Mold.description: This condiment will make any food break the mold. Or your stomach.

Tear Juice.name: Tear Juice
Tear Juice.description: A blinding substance extracted from certain onions.

Stabilized Nutriment.name: Stabilized Nutriment
Stabilized Nutriment.description: A bioengineered protien-nutrient structure designed to decompose in high saturation. In layman's terms, it won't get you fat.

Entropic Polypnium.name: Entropic Polypnium
Entropic Polypnium.description: An ichor, derived from a certain mushroom, makes for a bad time.

Tinea Luxor.name: Tinea Luxor
Tinea Luxor.description: A stimulating ichor which causes luminescent fungi to grow on the skin.

Vitrium Froth.name: Vitrium Froth
Vitrium Froth.description: A bubbly paste that heals wounds of the skin.

Clown's Tears.name: Clown's Tears
Clown's Tears.description: The sorrow and melancholy of a thousand bereaved clowns, forever denied their Honkmechs.

Liquid Electricity.name: Liquid Electricity
Liquid Electricity.description: A glowing, viscous substance that radiates pure energy.

Caramel.name: Caramel
Caramel.description: Who would have guessed that heated sugar could be so delicious?

BBQ Sauce.name: BBQ Sauce
BBQ Sauce.description: Sweet, smoky, savory, and gets everywhere. Perfect for grilling.

Laughin' Syrup.name: Laughin' Syrup
Laughin' Syrup.description: The product of juicing Laughin' Peas. Fizzy, and seems to change flavour based on what it's used with!

Pyre Elementum.name: Pyre Elementum
Pyre Elementum.description: This is what makes Fireblossoms even hotter.

Cheese Spread.name: Cheese Spread
Cheese Spread.description: I cant believe its not cheese!

Leporazine.name: Leporazine
Leporazine.description: Leporazine will effectively regulate a patient's body temperature, ensuring it never leaves safe levels.

Adminordrazine.name: Adminordrazine
Adminordrazine.description: It's magic. We don't have to explain it.

Quantum Medicine.name: Quantum Medicine
Quantum Medicine.description: Rare and experimental particles, that apparently swap the user's body with one from an alternate dimension where it's completely healthy.

Synaptizine.name: Synaptizine
Synaptizine.description: Increases resistance to stuns as well as reducing drowsiness and hallucinations.

Diphen-Synaptizine.name: Diphen-Synaptizine
Diphen-Synaptizine.description: Reduces drowsiness, hallucinations, and Histamine from body.

Cryoxadone.name: Cryoxadone
Cryoxadone.description: A chemical mixture with almost magical healing powers. Its main limitation is that the patient's body temperature must be under 270K for it to metabolise correctly.

Clonexadone.name: Clonexadone
Clonexadone.description: A chemical that derives from Cryoxadone. It specializes in healing clone damage, but nothing else. Requires very cold temperatures to properly metabolize, and metabolizes quicker than cryoxadone.

Pyroxadone.name: Pyroxadone
Pyroxadone.description: A mixture of cryoxadone and slime jelly, that apparently inverses the requirement for its activation.

Rezadone.name: Rezadone
Rezadone.description: A powder derived from fish toxin, Rezadone can effectively treat genetic damage as well as restoring minor wounds. Overdose will cause intense nausea and minor toxin damage.

Spaceacillin.name: Spaceacillin
Spaceacillin.description: Spaceacillin will prevent a patient from conventionally spreading any diseases they are currently infected with.

Silver Sulfadiazine.name: Silver Sulfadiazine
Silver Sulfadiazine.description: If used in touch-based applications, immediately restores burn wounds as well as restoring more over time. If ingested through other means or overdosed, deals minor toxin damage.

Oxandrolone.name: Oxandrolone
Oxandrolone.description: Stimulates the healing of severe burns. Extremely rapidly heals severe burns and slowly heals minor ones. Overdose will worsen existing burns.

Styptic Powder.name: Styptic Powder
Styptic Powder.description: If used in touch-based applications, immediately restores bruising as well as restoring more over time. If ingested through other means or overdosed, deals minor toxin damage.

Saline-Glucose Solution.name: Saline-Glucose Solution
Saline-Glucose Solution.description: Has a 33% chance per metabolism cycle to heal brute and burn damage. Can be used as a temporary blood substitute.

Miner's Salve.name: Miner's Salve
Miner's Salve.description: A powerful painkiller. Restores bruising and burns in addition to making the patient believe they are fully healed.

Synthflesh.name: Synthflesh
Synthflesh.description: Has a 100% chance of instantly healing brute and burn damage. One unit of the chemical will heal one point of damage. Touch application only.

Charcoal.name: Charcoal
Charcoal.description: Heals toxin damage as well as slowly removing any other chemicals the patient has in their bloodstream.

System Cleaner.name: System Cleaner
System Cleaner.description: Neutralizes harmful chemical compounds inside synthetic systems.

Omnizine.name: Omnizine
Omnizine.description: Slowly heals all damage types. Overdose will cause damage in all types instead.

Protozine.name: Protozine
Protozine.description: A less environmentally friendly and somewhat weaker variant of omnizine.

Calomel.name: Calomel
Calomel.description: Quickly purges the body of all chemicals. Toxin damage is dealt if the patient is in good condition.

Pentetic Acid.name: Pentetic Acid
Pentetic Acid.description: Reduces massive amounts of radiation and toxin damage while purging other chemicals from the body.

Emergency Radiation Purgant.name: Emergency Radiation Purgant
Emergency Radiation Purgant.description: Rapidly purges radiation from the body.

Salicylic Acid.name: Salicylic Acid
Salicylic Acid.description: Stimulates the healing of severe bruises. Extremely rapidly heals severe bruising and slowly heals minor ones. Overdose will worsen existing bruising.

Salbutamol.name: Salbutamol
Salbutamol.description: Rapidly restores oxygen deprivation as well as preventing more of it to an extent.

Perfluorodecalin.name: Perfluorodecalin
Perfluorodecalin.description: Restores oxygen deprivation while producing a lesser amount of toxic byproducts. Both scale with exposure to the drug and current amount of oxygen deprivation. Overdose causes toxic byproducts regardless of oxygen deprivation.

Ephedrine.name: Ephedrine
Ephedrine.description: Increases stun resistance and movement speed, giving you hand cramps. Overdose deals toxin damage and inhibits breathing.

Diphenhydramine.name: Diphenhydramine
Diphenhydramine.description: Rapidly purges the body of Histamine and reduces jitteriness. Slight chance of causing drowsiness.

Morphine.name: Morphine
Morphine.description: A painkiller that allows the patient to move at full speed even in bulky objects. Causes drowsiness and eventually unconsciousness in high doses. Overdose will cause a variety of effects, ranging from minor to lethal.

Tramal.name: Tramal
Tramal.description: A low intensity, high duration painkiller. Causes slight drowiness in extended use.

Dimorlin.name: Dimorlin
Dimorlin.description: A powerful opiate-derivative analgesiac. Extremely habit forming

Oculine.name: Oculine
Oculine.description: Quickly restores eye damage, cures nearsightedness, and has a chance to restore vision to the blind.

Inacusiate.name: Inacusiate
Inacusiate.description: Instantly restores all hearing to the patient, but does not cure deafness.

Atropine.name: Atropine
Atropine.description: If a patient is in critical condition, rapidly heals all damage types as well as regulating oxygen in the body. Excellent for stabilizing wounded patients.

Epinephrine.name: Epinephrine
Epinephrine.description: Very minor boost to stun resistance. Slowly heals damage if a patient is in critical condition, as well as regulating oxygen loss. Overdose causes weakness and toxin damage.

Strange Reagent.name: Strange Reagent
Strange Reagent.description: A miracle drug capable of bringing the dead back to life. Works topically unless anotamically complex, in which case works orally. Only works if the target has less than 200 total brute and burn damage and hasn't been husked and requires more reagent depending on damage inflicted. Causes damage to the living.

Neurine.name: Neurine
Neurine.description: Reacts with neural tissue, helping reform damaged connections. Can cure minor traumas.

Mutadone.name: Mutadone
Mutadone.description: Removes jitteriness and restores genetic defects.

Antihol.name: Antihol
Antihol.description: Purges alcoholic substance from the patient's body and eliminates its side effects.

Indoril.name: Indoril
Indoril.description: Increases stun resistance and movement speed in addition to restoring minor damage and weakness. Overdose causes weakness and toxin damage.

Bicaridine.name: Bicaridine
Bicaridine.description: Restores bruising. Overdose causes it instead.

Bicaridine Plus.name: Bicaridine Plus
Bicaridine Plus.description: Restores bruising and slowly stems bleeding. Overdose causes it instead. More effective than standardized Bicaridine.

Dexalin.name: Dexalin
Dexalin.description: Restores oxygen loss. Overdose causes it instead.

Dexalin Plus.name: Dexalin Plus
Dexalin Plus.description: Restores oxygen loss and purges Lexorin. Overdose causes it instead. More effective than standardized Dexalin.

Kelotane.name: Kelotane
Kelotane.description: Heals burn damage. Overdose causes it instead.

Dermaline.name: Dermaline
Dermaline.description: Heals burn damage. Overdose causes it instead. Superior to standardized Kelotane in healing capacity.

Dylovene.name: Dylovene
Dylovene.description: Heals toxin damage and removes toxins in the bloodstream. Overdose causes toxin damage.

Inaprovaline.name: Inaprovaline
Inaprovaline.description: Stabilizes the breathing of patients. Good for those in critical condition.

Tricordrazine.name: Tricordrazine
Tricordrazine.description: A weak dilutant that slowly heals brute, burn, and toxin damage.
Tricordrazine.taste_description: water that has been standing still in a glass on a counter overnight

Tetracordrazine.name: Tetracordrazine
Tetracordrazine.description: A weak dilutant similar to Tricordrazine that slowly heals all damage types.
Tetracordrazine.taste_description: bottled water that has been sitting out in the sun with a single chili flake in it

Regenerative Jelly.name: Regenerative Jelly
Regenerative Jelly.description: Gradually regenerates all types of damage, without harming slime anatomy.

Restorative Nanites.name: Restorative Nanites
Restorative Nanites.description: Miniature medical robots that swiftly restore bodily damage.

Earthsblood.name: Earthsblood
Earthsblood.description: Ichor from an extremely powerful plant. Great for restoring wounds, but it's a little heavy on the brain. For some strange reason, it also induces temporary pacifism in those who imbibe it and semi-permanent pacifism in those who overdose on it.

Haloperidol.name: Haloperidol
Haloperidol.description: Increases depletion rates for most stimulating/hallucinogenic drugs. Reduces druggy effects and jitteriness. Severe stamina regeneration penalty, causes drowsiness. Small chance of brain damage.

Lavaland Extract.name: Lavaland Extract
Lavaland Extract.description: An extract of lavaland atmospheric and mineral elements. Heals the user in small doses, but is extremely toxic otherwise.

Changeling Adrenaline.name: Changeling Adrenaline
Changeling Adrenaline.description: Reduces the duration of unconciousness, knockdown and stuns. Restores stamina, but deals toxin damage when overdosed.

Changeling Haste.name: Changeling Haste
Changeling Haste.description: Drastically increases movement speed, but deals toxin damage.

Corazone.name: Corazone
Corazone.description: A medication used to treat pain, fever, and inflammation, along with heart attacks. Can also be used to stabilize livers.

Cordiolis Hepatico.name: Cordiolis Hepatico
Cordiolis Hepatico.description: A strange, pitch-black reagent that seems to absorb all light. Effects unknown.

Muscle Stimulant.name: Muscle Stimulant
Muscle Stimulant.description: A potent chemical that allows someone under its influence to be at full physical ability even when under massive amounts of pain.

Modafinil.name: Modafinil
Modafinil.description: Long-lasting sleep suppressant that very slightly reduces stun and knockdown times. Overdosing has horrendous side effects and deals lethal oxygen damage, will knock you unconscious if not dealt with.

Psicodine.name: Psicodine
Psicodine.description: Suppresses anxiety and other various forms of mental distress. Overdose causes hallucinations and minor toxin damage.

Mitogen Metabolism Factor.name: Mitogen Metabolism Factor
Mitogen Metabolism Factor.description: This enzyme catalyzes the conversion of nutricious food into healing peptides.

Silibinin.name: Silibinin
Silibinin.description: A thistle derrived hepatoprotective flavolignan mixture that help reverse damage to the liver.

Polypyrylium Oligomers.name: Polypyrylium Oligomers
Polypyrylium Oligomers.description: A purple mixture of short polyelectrolyte chains not easily synthesized in the laboratory. It is valued as an intermediate in the synthesis of the cutting edge pharmaceuticals.

Carthatoline.name: Carthatoline
Carthatoline.description: An evacuant that induces vomiting and purges toxins, as well as healing toxin damage. Superior to Dylovene. Overdose causes toxin damage.

C4L-Z1UM Agent.name: C4L-Z1UM Agent
C4L-Z1UM Agent.description: A peculiar substance capable of instantly regenerating live tissue.

Converbital.name: Converbital
Converbital.description: A substance capable of regenerating torn flesh, however, due to its extremely exothermic nature, use may result in burns

Convuri.name: Convuri
Convuri.description: A substance capable of regenerating burnt skin with ease, however, the speed at which it does this has been known to cause muscular tearing

Trophazole.name: Trophazole
Trophazole.description: Orginally developed as fitness supplement, this chemical accelerates wound healing and if ingested turns nutriment into healing peptides

Rhigoxane.name: Rhigoxane
Rhigoxane.description: A second generation burn treatment agent exhibiting a cooling effect that is especially pronounced when deployed as a spray. Its high halogen content helps extinguish fires.

Thializid.name: Thializid
Thializid.description: A potent antidote for intravenous use with a narrow therapeutic index, it is considered an active prodrug of oxalizid.

Oxalizid.name: Oxalizid
Oxalizid.description: The active metabolite of thializid. Causes muscle weakness on overdose

Soulus Dust.name: Soulus Dust
Soulus Dust.description: Ground legion cores. The dust quickly seals wounds yet slowly causes the tissue to undergo necrosis.

Skeleton’s Boon.name: Skeleton’s Boon
Skeleton’s Boon.description: A robust solution of minerals that greatly strengthens the bones.

Lithium Carbonate.name: Lithium Carbonate
Lithium Carbonate.description: A mood stabilizer discovered by most spacefaring civilizations. Fairly widespread as a result.

Human Sleep Hormone.name: Human Sleep Hormone
Human Sleep Hormone.description: A compound typically found within Solarians. The exact effects vary on the species it is administered to.

Stasis.name: Stasis
Stasis.description: A liquid blue chemical that causes the body to enter a chemically induced stasis, irregardless of current state.

Carfencadrizine.name: Carfencadrizine
Carfencadrizine.description: A highly potent synthetic painkiller held in a suspension of stimulating agents. Allows people to keep moving long beyond when they should stop.

chitosan.name: chitosan
chitosan.description: Vastly improves the blood's natural ability to coagulate and stop bleeding by hightening platelet production and effectiveness. Overdosing will cause extreme blood clotting, resulting in potential brain damage.

Liquid gibs.name: Liquid gibs
Liquid gibs.description: You don't even want to think about what's in here.

Water.name: Water
Water.description: An ubiquitous chemical substance that is composed of hydrogen and oxygen.

Hollow Water.name: Hollow Water
Hollow Water.description: An ubiquitous chemical substance that is composed of hydrogen and oxygen, but it looks kinda hollow.

Hydrogen peroxide.name: Hydrogen peroxide
Hydrogen peroxide.description: An ubiquitous chemical substance that is composed of hydrogen and oxygen and oxygen.

Unholy Water.name: Unholy Water
Unholy Water.description: Something that shouldn't exist on this plane of existence.

Godblood.name: Godblood
Godblood.description: Slowly heals all damage types. Has a rather high overdose threshold. Glows with mysterious power.

Space Lube.name: Space Lube
Space Lube.description: Lubricant is a substance introduced between two moving surfaces to reduce the friction and wear between them. giggity.

Super Duper Lube.name: Super Duper Lube
Super Duper Lube.description: This \[REDACTED\] has been outlawed after the incident on \[DATA EXPUNGED\].

Spray Tan.name: Spray Tan
Spray Tan.description: A substance applied to the skin to darken the skin.

Mulligan Toxin.name: Mulligan Toxin
Mulligan Toxin.description: This toxin will rapidly change the DNA of human beings. Commonly used by Syndicate spies and assassins in need of an emergency ID change.

Advanced Mutation Toxin.name: Advanced Mutation Toxin
Advanced Mutation Toxin.description: An advanced corruptive toxin produced by slimes.

Gluttony's Blessing.name: Gluttony's Blessing
Gluttony's Blessing.description: An advanced corruptive toxin produced by something terrible.

Serotrotium.name: Serotrotium
Serotrotium.description: A chemical compound that promotes concentrated production of the serotonin neurotransmitter in humans.

Oxygen.name: Oxygen
Oxygen.description: A colorless, odorless gas. Grows on trees but is still pretty valuable.

Ozone.name: Ozone
Ozone.description: A pale blue gas, with a distinct smell. While it is oxygen with an extra molecule attached, it is quite dangerous.

Copper.name: Copper
Copper.description: A highly ductile metal. Things made out of copper aren't very durable, but it makes a decent material for electrical wiring.

Nitrogen.name: Nitrogen
Nitrogen.description: A colorless, odorless, tasteless gas. A simple asphyxiant that can silently displace vital oxygen.

Hydrogen.name: Hydrogen
Hydrogen.description: A colorless, odorless, nonmetallic, tasteless, highly combustible diatomic gas.

Potassium.name: Potassium
Potassium.description: A soft, low-melting solid that can easily be cut with a knife. Reacts violently with water.

Mercury.name: Mercury
Mercury.description: A curious metal that's a liquid at room temperature. Neurodegenerative and very bad for the mind.

Sulfur.name: Sulfur
Sulfur.description: A sickly yellow solid mostly known for its nasty smell. It's actually much more helpful than it looks in biochemisty.

Carbon.name: Carbon
Carbon.description: A crumbly black solid that, while unexciting on a physical level, forms the base of all known life. Kind of a big deal.

Chlorine.name: Chlorine
Chlorine.description: A pale yellow gas that's well known as an oxidizer. While it forms many harmless molecules in its elemental form it is far from harmless.

Hydrogen Chloride.name: Hydrogen Chloride
Hydrogen Chloride.description: A colorless gas that turns into hydrochloric acid in the presence of water.

Fluorine.name: Fluorine
Fluorine.description: A comically-reactive chemical element. The universe does not want this stuff to exist in this form in the slightest.

Sodium.name: Sodium
Sodium.description: A soft silver metal that can easily be cut with a knife. It's not salt just yet, so refrain from putting it on your chips.

Phosphorus.name: Phosphorus
Phosphorus.description: A ruddy red powder that burns readily. Though it comes in many colors, the general theme is always the same.

Lithium.name: Lithium
Lithium.description: A silver metal, its claim to fame is its remarkably low density. Using it is a bit too effective in calming oneself down.

Glycerol.name: Glycerol
Glycerol.description: Glycerol is a simple polyol compound. Glycerol is sweet-tasting and of low toxicity.

Sterilizine.name: Sterilizine
Sterilizine.description: Sterilizes wounds in preparation for surgery.

Gold.name: Gold
Gold.description: Gold is a dense, soft, shiny metal and the most malleable and ductile metal known.

Silver.name: Silver
Silver.description: A soft, white, lustrous transition metal, it has the highest electrical conductivity of any element and the highest thermal conductivity of any metal.

Uranium.name: Uranium
Uranium.description: A jade-green metallic chemical element in the actinide series, weakly radioactive.

Radium.name: Radium
Radium.description: Radium is an alkaline earth metal. It is extremely radioactive.

Bluespace Dust.name: Bluespace Dust
Bluespace Dust.description: A dust composed of microscopic bluespace crystals, with minor space-warping properties.

Aluminium.name: Aluminium
Aluminium.description: A silvery white and ductile member of the boron group of chemical elements.

Silicon.name: Silicon
Silicon.description: A tetravalent metalloid, silicon is less reactive than its chemical analog carbon.

Space cleaner.name: Space cleaner
Space cleaner.description: A compound used to clean things. Now with 50% more sodium hypochlorite!

EZ Clean.name: EZ Clean
EZ Clean.description: A powerful, acidic cleaner sold by Waffle Co. Affects organic matter while leaving other objects unaffected.

Impedrezene.name: Impedrezene
Impedrezene.description: Impedrezene is a narcotic that impedes one's ability by slowing down the higher brain cell functions.

Xenomicrobes.name: Xenomicrobes
Xenomicrobes.description: Microbes with an entirely alien cellular structure.

Agent-S.name: Agent-S
Agent-S.description: Virological agent that infects the subject with Gastrolosis.

Fluorosurfactant.name: Fluorosurfactant
Fluorosurfactant.description: A perfluoronated sulfonic acid that forms a foam when mixed with water.

Foaming agent.name: Foaming agent
Foaming agent.description: An agent that yields metallic foam when mixed with light metal and a strong acid.

Smart foaming agent.name: Smart foaming agent
Smart foaming agent.description: An agent that yields metallic foam which conforms to area boundaries when mixed with light metal and a strong acid.

Ammonia.name: Ammonia
Ammonia.description: A caustic substance commonly used in fertilizer or household cleaners.

Carbon Dioxide.name: Carbon Dioxide
Carbon Dioxide.description: A gas commonly produced by burning carbon fuels. You're constantly producing this in your lungs.

Nitrous Oxide.name: Nitrous Oxide
Nitrous Oxide.description: A potent oxidizer used as fuel in rockets and as an anaesthetic during surgery.

Carbon Monoxide.name: Carbon Monoxide
Carbon Monoxide.description: A highly dangerous gas for sapients.

Stimulum.name: Stimulum
Stimulum.description: An unstable experimental gas that greatly increases the energy of those that inhale it.

Nitryl.name: Nitryl
Nitryl.description: A highly reactive gas that makes you feel faster.

Mundane Powder.name: Mundane Powder
Mundane Powder.description: A powder that is used for coloring things.

= \"none\").name: = "none")
= \"none\").description: A rather mundane-looking powder. It doesn't look like it'd color much of anything...

Generic nutriment.name: Generic nutriment
Generic nutriment.description: Some kind of nutriment. You can't really tell what it is. You should probably report it, along with how you obtained it.

E-Z-Nutrient.name: E-Z-Nutrient
E-Z-Nutrient.description: Contains electrolytes. It's what plants crave.

Left 4 Zed.name: Left 4 Zed
Left 4 Zed.description: Unstable nutriment that makes plants mutate more often than usual.

Robust Harvest.name: Robust Harvest
Robust Harvest.description: Very potent nutriment that slows plants from mutating.

Enduro Grow.name: Enduro Grow
Enduro Grow.description: A specialized nutriment, which decreases product quantity and potency, but strengthens the plants endurance.

Liquid Earthquake.name: Liquid Earthquake
Liquid Earthquake.description: A specialized nutriment, which increases the plant's production speed, as well as it's susceptibility to weeds.

Oil.name: Oil
Oil.description: Burns in a small smoky fire, can be used to get Ash.

Stable Plasma.name: Stable Plasma
Stable Plasma.description: Non-flammable plasma locked into a liquid form that cannot ignite or become gaseous/solid.

Iodine.name: Iodine
Iodine.description: Commonly added to table salt as a nutrient. On its own it tastes far less pleasing.

Carpet.name: Carpet
Carpet.description: For those that need a more creative way to roll out a red carpet.

Black Carpet.name: Black Carpet
Black Carpet.description: The carpet also comes in... BLAPCK

Blue Carpet.name: Blue Carpet
Blue Carpet.description: For those that really need to chill out for a while.

Cyan Carpet.name: Cyan Carpet
Cyan Carpet.description: For those that need a throwback to the years of using poison as a construction material. Smells like asbestos.

Green Carpet.name: Green Carpet
Green Carpet.description: For those that need the perfect flourish for green eggs and ham.

Orange Carpet.name: Orange Carpet
Orange Carpet.description: For those that prefer a healthy carpet to go along with their healthy diet.

Purple Carpet.name: Purple Carpet
Purple Carpet.description: For those that need to waste copious amounts of healing jelly in order to look fancy.

Red Carpet.name: Red Carpet
Red Carpet.description: For those that need an even redder carpet.

Royal Carpet?.name: Royal Carpet?
Royal Carpet?.description: For those that break the game and need to make an issue report.

Royal Black Carpet.name: Royal Black Carpet
Royal Black Carpet.description: For those that feel the need to show off their timewasting skills.

Royal Blue Carpet.name: Royal Blue Carpet
Royal Blue Carpet.description: For those that feel the need to show off their timewasting skills.. in BLUE.

Genesis Serum.name: Genesis Serum
Genesis Serum.description: A mysterious substance capable of spontaneously gestating plant life when given a surface to adhere to.

Bromine.name: Bromine
Bromine.description: A brownish liquid that's highly reactive. Useful for stopping free radicals, but not intended for human consumption.

Pentaerythritol.name: Pentaerythritol
Pentaerythritol.description: Slow down, it ain't no spelling bee!

Acetaldehyde.name: Acetaldehyde
Acetaldehyde.description: Similar to plastic. Tastes like dead people.

Phenol.name: Phenol
Phenol.description: An aromatic ring of carbon with a hydroxyl group. A useful precursor to some medicines, but has no healing properties on its own.

Ash.name: Ash
Ash.description: Supposedly phoenixes rise from these, but you've never seen it.

Acetone.name: Acetone
Acetone.description: A slick, slightly carcinogenic liquid. Has a multitude of mundane uses in everyday life.

Quantum Hair Dye.name: Quantum Hair Dye
Quantum Hair Dye.description: Has a high chance of making you look like a mad scientist.

Barber's Aid.name: Barber's Aid
Barber's Aid.description: A solution to hair loss across the world.

Concentrated Barber's Aid.name: Concentrated Barber's Aid
Concentrated Barber's Aid.description: A concentrated solution to hair loss across the world.

Baldium.name: Baldium
Baldium.description: A major cause of hair loss across the world.

Lye.name: Lye
Lye.description: Also known as sodium hydroxide. As a profession making this is somewhat underwhelming.

Drying agent.name: Drying agent
Drying agent.description: A desiccant. Can be used to dry things.

royal bee jelly.name: royal bee jelly
royal bee jelly.description: Royal Bee Jelly, if injected into a Queen Space Bee said bee will split into two bees.

Romerol.name: Romerol
Romerol.description: "Romerol is a highly experimental bioterror agent \

Magillitis.name: Magillitis
Magillitis.description: An experimental serum which causes rapid muscular growth in Hominidae. Side-affects may include hypertrichosis, violent outbursts, and an unending affinity for bananas.

Growth Serum.name: Growth Serum
Growth Serum.description: A strange chemical that causes growth, but wears off over time. The growth effect is limited.

plastic polymers.name: plastic polymers
plastic polymers.description: the petroleum based components of plastic.

generic glitter.name: generic glitter
generic glitter.description: if you can see this description, contact a coder.

Pax.name: Pax
Pax.description: A colorless liquid that suppresses violence in its subjects.

BZ metabolites.name: BZ metabolites
BZ metabolites.description: A harmless metabolite of BZ gas.

Synthpax.name: Synthpax
Synthpax.description: A colorless liquid that suppresses violence in its subjects. Cheaper to synthesize than normal Pax, but wears off faster.

Dizzying Solution.name: Dizzying Solution
Dizzying Solution.description: Makes the target off balance and dizzy

Tiring Solution.name: Tiring Solution
Tiring Solution.description: An extremely weak stamina-toxin that tires out the target. Completely harmless.

Spider Extract.name: Spider Extract
Spider Extract.description: A highly specialized extract coming from the Australicus sector, used to create broodmother spiders.

Organic Slurry.name: Organic Slurry
Organic Slurry.description: A mixture of various colors of fluid. Induces vomiting.

Wittel.name: Wittel
Wittel.description: An extremely rare metallic-white substance only found on demon-class planets.

Metalgen.name: Metalgen
Metalgen.description: A purple metal morphic liquid, said to impose it's metallic properties on whatever it touches.

Gravitum.name: Gravitum
Gravitum.description: A rare kind of null fluid, capable of temporalily removing all weight of whatever it touches.

Cellulose Fibers.name: Cellulose Fibers
Cellulose Fibers.description: A crystaline polydextrose polymer, plants swear by this stuff.

Gravy.name: Gravy
Gravy.description: A mixture of flour, water, and the juices of cooked meat.

Determination.name: Determination
Determination.description: For when you need to push on a little more. Do NOT allow near plants.

Crystal Reagent.name: Crystal Reagent
Crystal Reagent.description: A strange crystal substance. Heals faster than omnizine.

Concrete Mix.name: Concrete Mix
Concrete Mix.description: Pre-made concrete mix, ideal for lazy engineers.

Cement.name: Cement
Cement.description: A sophisticated binding agent used to produce concrete.

Hexement.name: Hexement
Hexement.description: An advanced, space-age binding agent used to produce reinforced concrete.

Road mixture.name: Road mixture
Road mixture.description: A mix of cement and asphalt. Looks less tasty than normal cement.

Concrete.name: Concrete
Concrete.description: A mix of cement and aggregate, commonly used as a bulk building material.

Hexacrete.name: Hexacrete
Hexacrete.description: Made with fortified cement, this mix of binder and aggregate is a useful, sturdy building material.

Pavement.name: Pavement
Pavement.description: Road surface, blacktop, asphalt concrete, whatever you call it, it's the most common material used in constructing runways for ships and roadways for vehicles.

Calcium.name: Calcium
Calcium.description: A dull gray metal important to bones.

Ashen Fibers.name: Ashen Fibers
Ashen Fibers.description: Ground plant fibers from a cave fern. Useful for medicines.

Titanium.name: Titanium
Titanium.description: A light, reflective grey metal used in ship construction.

Asphalt.name: Asphalt
Asphalt.description: A dark, viscous liquid. Often found in oil deposits, although sometimes it can seep to the surface.

Polar Bear Fur.name: Polar Bear Fur
Polar Bear Fur.description: Fur obtained from griding up a polar bears hide

Illestren Bacteria.name: Illestren Bacteria
Illestren Bacteria.description: Bacteria native to the Saint-Roumain Militia home planet.

Anti-Radiation Foam.name: Anti-Radiation Foam
Anti-Radiation Foam.description: A tried and tested foam, used for decontaminating nuclear disasters.

Sulfur Dioxide.name: Sulfur Dioxide
Sulfur Dioxide.description: A transparent gas produced by geological activity and burning certain fuels.

Thermite.name: Thermite
Thermite.description: Thermite produces an aluminothermic reaction known as a thermite reaction. Can be used to melt walls.

Nitroglycerin.name: Nitroglycerin
Nitroglycerin.description: Nitroglycerin is a heavy, colorless, oily, explosive liquid obtained by nitrating glycerol.

Stabilizing Agent.name: Stabilizing Agent
Stabilizing Agent.description: Keeps unstable chemicals stable. This does not work on everything.

Chlorine Trifluoride.name: Chlorine Trifluoride
Chlorine Trifluoride.description: Makes a temporary 3x3 fireball when it comes into existence, so be careful when mixing. ClF3 applied to a surface burns things that wouldn't otherwise burn, including typically-robust flooring, potentially exposing it to the vacuum of space.

Sorium.name: Sorium
Sorium.description: Sends everything flying from the detonation point.

Liquid Dark Matter.name: Liquid Dark Matter
Liquid Dark Matter.description: Sucks everything into the detonation point.

Smoke Powder.name: Smoke Powder
Smoke Powder.description: Makes a large cloud of smoke that can carry reagents.

Dense Smoke Powder.name: Dense Smoke Powder
Dense Smoke Powder.description: Makes a large cloud of thick smoke that can carry reagents.

Phlogiston.name: Phlogiston
Phlogiston.description: Catches you on fire and makes you ignite.

Cryostylane.name: Cryostylane
Cryostylane.description: Comes into existence at 20K. As long as there is sufficient oxygen for it to react with, Cryostylane slowly cools all other reagents in the container 0K.

Pyrosium.name: Pyrosium
Pyrosium.description: Comes into existence at 20K. As long as there is sufficient oxygen for it to react with, Pyrosium slowly heats all other reagents in the container.

Teslium.name: Teslium
Teslium.description: An unstable, electrically-charged metallic slurry. Periodically electrocutes its victim, and makes electrocutions against them more deadly. Excessively heating teslium results in dangerous destabilization. Do not allow to come into contact with water.

Energized Jelly.name: Energized Jelly
Energized Jelly.description: Electrically-charged jelly. Boosts jellypeople's nervous system, but only shocks other lifeforms.

Firefighting Foam.name: Firefighting Foam
Firefighting Foam.description: A historical fire suppressant. Originally believed to simply displace oxygen to starve fires, it actually interferes with the combustion reaction itself. Vastly superior to the cheap water-based extinguishers found on NT vessels.
Firefighting Foam.taste_description: the inside of a fire extinguisher

Amatoxin.name: Amatoxin
Amatoxin.description: A powerful poison derived from certain species of mushroom.

Unstable mutagen.name: Unstable mutagen
Unstable mutagen.description: Might cause unpredictable mutations. Keep away from children.

Hot Ice Slush.name: Hot Ice Slush
Hot Ice Slush.description: Frozen plasma. To the right people, it's worth its weight in gold

Lexorin.name: Lexorin
Lexorin.description: A powerful poison used to stop respiration.

Slime Jelly.name: Slime Jelly
Slime Jelly.description: A gooey semi-liquid produced from one of the deadliest lifeforms in existence. SO REAL.

Mint Toxin.name: Mint Toxin
Mint Toxin.description: Useful for dealing with undesirable customers.

Carpotoxin.name: Carpotoxin
Carpotoxin.description: A deadly neurotoxin produced by the dreaded spess carp.

Zombie Powder.name: Zombie Powder
Zombie Powder.description: A strong neurotoxin that puts the subject into a death-like state.

Ghoul Powder.name: Ghoul Powder
Ghoul Powder.description: A strong neurotoxin that slows metabolism to a death-like state, while keeping the patient fully active. Causes toxin buildup if used too long.

Mindbreaker Toxin.name: Mindbreaker Toxin
Mindbreaker Toxin.description: A powerful hallucinogen. Not a thing to be messed with. For some mental patients. it counteracts their symptoms and anchors them to reality.

Plant-B-Gone.name: Plant-B-Gone
Plant-B-Gone.description: A harmful toxic mixture to kill plantlife. Do not ingest!

Weed Killer.name: Weed Killer
Weed Killer.description: A harmful toxic mixture to kill weeds. Do not ingest!

Pest Killer.name: Pest Killer
Pest Killer.description: A harmful toxic mixture to kill pests. Do not ingest!

Spore Toxin.name: Spore Toxin
Spore Toxin.description: A natural toxin produced by blob spores that inhibits vision when ingested.

Burning Spore Toxin.name: Burning Spore Toxin
Burning Spore Toxin.description: A natural toxin produced by blob spores that induces combustion in its victim.

Chloral Hydrate.name: Chloral Hydrate
Chloral Hydrate.description: A powerful sedative that induces confusion and drowsiness before putting its target to sleep.

Beer?.name: Beer?
Beer?.description: A specially-engineered sedative disguised as beer. It induces instant sleep in its target.

Coffee Grounds.name: Coffee Grounds
Coffee Grounds.description: Finely ground coffee beans, used to make coffee.

Ground Tea Leaves.name: Ground Tea Leaves
Ground Tea Leaves.description: Finely shredded tea leaves, used for making tea.

Mute Toxin.name: Mute Toxin
Mute Toxin.description: A nonlethal poison that inhibits speech in its victim.

Tirizene.name: Tirizene
Tirizene.description: A nonlethal poison that causes extreme fatigue and weakness in its victim.

Polonium.name: Polonium
Polonium.description: An extremely radioactive material in liquid form. Ingestion results in fatal irradiation.

Histamine.name: Histamine
Histamine.description: Histamine's effects become more dangerous depending on the dosage amount. They range from mildly annoying to incredibly lethal.

Formaldehyde.name: Formaldehyde
Formaldehyde.description: Formaldehyde, on its own, is a fairly weak toxin. It contains trace amounts of Histamine, very rarely making it decay into Histamine.

Venom.name: Venom
Venom.description: An exotic poison extracted from highly toxic fauna. Causes scaling amounts of toxin damage and bruising depending and dosage. Often decays into Histamine.

Fentanyl.name: Fentanyl
Fentanyl.description: Fentanyl will inhibit brain function and cause toxin damage before eventually knocking out its victim.

Cyanide.name: Cyanide
Cyanide.description: An infamous poison known for its use in assassination. Causes small amounts of toxin damage with a small chance of oxygen damage or a stun.

Bad Food.name: Bad Food
Bad Food.description: The result of some abomination of cookery, food so bad it's toxic.

Itching Powder.name: Itching Powder
Itching Powder.description: A powder that induces itching upon contact with the skin. Causes the victim to scratch at their itches and has a very low chance to decay into Histamine.

Initropidril.name: Initropidril
Initropidril.description: A powerful poison with insidious effects. It can cause stuns, lethal breathing failure, and cardiac arrest.

Pancuronium.name: Pancuronium
Pancuronium.description: An undetectable toxin that swiftly incapacitates its victim. May also cause breathing failure.

Sodium Thiopental.name: Sodium Thiopental
Sodium Thiopental.description: Sodium Thiopental induces heavy weakness in its target as well as unconsciousness.

Sulfonal.name: Sulfonal
Sulfonal.description: A stealthy poison that deals minor toxin damage and eventually puts the target to sleep.

Amanitin.name: Amanitin
Amanitin.description: A very powerful delayed toxin. Upon full metabolization, a massive amount of toxin damage will be dealt depending on how long it has been in the victim's bloodstream.

Lipolicide.name: Lipolicide
Lipolicide.description: A powerful toxin that will destroy fat cells, massively reducing body weight in a short time. Deadly to those without nutriment in their body.

Coniine.name: Coniine
Coniine.description: Coniine metabolizes extremely slowly, but deals high amounts of toxin damage and stops breathing.

Spewium.name: Spewium
Spewium.description: A powerful emetic, causes uncontrollable vomiting.  May result in vomiting organs at high doses.

Curare.name: Curare
Curare.description: Causes slight toxin damage followed by chain-stunning and oxygen damage.

Heparin.name: Heparin
Heparin.description: A powerful anticoagulant. All open cut wounds on the victim will open up and bleed much faster

Rotatium.name: Rotatium
Rotatium.description: A constantly swirling, oddly colourful fluid. Causes the consumer's sense of direction and hand-eye coordination to become wild.

Skewium.name: Skewium
Skewium.description: A strange, dull coloured liquid that appears to warp back and forth inside its container. Causes any consumer to experience a visual phenomena similar to said warping.

Anacea.name: Anacea
Anacea.description: A toxin that quickly purges medicines and metabolizes very slowly.

Sulphuric acid.name: Sulphuric acid
Sulphuric acid.description: A strong mineral acid with the molecular formula H2SO4.

Fluorosulfuric acid.name: Fluorosulfuric acid
Fluorosulfuric acid.description: Fluorosulfuric acid is an extremely corrosive chemical substance.

Nitric acid.name: Nitric acid
Nitric acid.description: Nitric acid is an extremely corrosive chemical substance that violently reacts with living organic tissue.

Toxin Microcapsules.name: Toxin Microcapsules
Toxin Microcapsules.description: Causes heavy toxin damage after a brief time of inactivity.

Mime's Bane.name: Mime's Bane
Mime's Bane.description: A nonlethal neurotoxin that interferes with the victim's ability to gesture.

Bone Hurting Juice.name: Bone Hurting Juice
Bone Hurting Juice.description: A strange substance that looks a lot like water. Drinking it is oddly tempting. Oof ouch.

Bungotoxin.name: Bungotoxin
Bungotoxin.description: A horrible cardiotoxin that protects the humble bungo pit.

Lead Acetate.name: Lead Acetate
Lead Acetate.description: Used hundreds of years ago as a sweetener, before it was realized that it's incredibly poisonous.

Wine Of Ash.name: Wine Of Ash
Wine Of Ash.description: A traditional sacrament for members of the Saint-Roumain Militia. Believed to grant visions, seeing use both in ritual and entertainment within the Militia.
Wine Of Ash.taste_description: a rustic fruit, with hints of sweet yet tangy ash.

Wine Of Ice.name: Wine Of Ice
Wine Of Ice.description: A specialized brew utilized by members of the Saint-Roumain Militia, designed to assist in temperature regulation while working in hot environments. Known to give one the cold shoulder when thrown.
Wine Of Ice.taste_description: a weighty meat, undercut by a mild pepper.

Lightning's Blessing.name: Lightning's Blessing
Lightning's Blessing.description: A stimulating brew utilized by members of the Saint-Roumain Militia, created to allow trackers to keep up with highly mobile prey. Known to have a shocking effect when thrown

Hearthflame.name: Hearthflame
Hearthflame.description: A fiery brew utilized by members of the Saint-Roumain Militia, engineered to heat the body and cauterize wounds. Goes out in a blaze of glory when thrown.
Hearthflame.taste_description: apple cut apart by tangy pricks

Forcewine.name: Forcewine
Forcewine.description: Creates a barrier on the skin that catches shrapnel and when reversed locks threats down with a barrier

Prismwine.name: Prismwine
Prismwine.description: A glittering brew utilized by members of the Saint-Roumain Militia, mixed to defend against the blasts and burns of foes and fauna alike. Softens targets against your own burns when thrown.

Beer.name: Beer
Beer.description: An alcoholic beverage, brewed originally to keep a safe source of drinking water. A timeless classic.

Light Beer.name: Light Beer
Light Beer.description: An alcoholic beverage, brewed originally to keep a safe source of drinking water. This variety has reduced calorie and alcohol content.

Kahlua.name: Kahlua
Kahlua.description: A widely known coffee-flavoured liqueur. Still labeled under an old name from Earth, despite the loss of history.

Vodka.name: Vodka
Vodka.description: A clear, hard liquor. Doubles as a flammable fuel source, if you really need it.

Gin.name: Gin
Gin.description: A very sharp alcohol, with a flavor that's distinctly fresh.

Rum.name: Rum
Rum.description: The liquor of choice for sailors and spacers alike.

Vermouth.name: Vermouth
Vermouth.description: A fine wine to go with a meal.

Wine.name: Wine
Wine.description: An alcoholic beverage made from fermented grapes of all kinds.

Blueflame Pyrecask.name: Blueflame Pyrecask
Blueflame Pyrecask.description: A popular Zohil beverage, made by infusing specially-gathered cacti and grapes in ethanol.

Grappa.name: Grappa
Grappa.description: A fine brandy mixed with spirits.

Amaretto.name: Amaretto
Amaretto.description: A gentle drink that carries a sweet aroma.

Cognac.name: Cognac
Cognac.description: A sweet and strongly alcoholic drink, made after numerous distillations and years of maturing.

Absinthe.name: Absinthe
